'''Shades of Mort'ton''' is a [[combat]] and [[skilling]] [[minigame]] that takes place in [[Mort'ton]]. Players are to defend and build the [[Flamtaer|Flamtaer temple]] and create [[pyre logs]] to cremate [[shade remains]], which have a chance to yield [[Shade key|keys]] used for unlocking special chests. The minigame can also yield [[Combat]], [[Crafting]], [[Firemaking]], and [[Prayer]] experience.
